messages:
alex.k: FYI customer reported a 400 on /v1/rerank. They say it worked yesterday. Attaching snippet from their request and the error.

alex.k: support ticket TKT-4792 — customer app (node 16, axios) -> rerank returns 400 "Invalid request". No other details in body.

alex.k: Payload they send (copied from logs):
```json
{
  \"items\": "[{\"id\":\"a\",\"text\":\"foo\"},{\"id\":\"b\",\"text\":\"bar\"}]",
  \"query\": \"Which is better?\",
  \"topK\": 1
}
```

alex.k: Notice `items` is a string (stringified JSON) not an array. They say their client serializes twice when batch size > 1.

maria.cs: Oof, double-encoding. API expects items: [] array of objects. Do we return a helpful error? Customer says body error is generic "Invalid request" which isn't actionable.

ryan.eng: @maria.cs can you paste the request headers from the logs? If content-type was text/plain maybe body ended up as string at proxy.

alex.k: Headers (from proxy):
```
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
User-Agent: customer-app/1.4.2
X-Forwarded-For: 203.0.113.45
```

ryan.eng: Hmm content-type looks fine. So client is serializing the array into a string field inside JSON. That would pass JSON schema (items: string) but fail our type checks expecting array. We should return a 400 with a message like "items must be an array of candidate objects".

maria.cs: Agreed. Can we reproduce locally? @ingest-team any chance the SDK or proxy might accept stringified arrays and coerce?

ingest-team: we don't coerce string->array. We validate schema at the edge and currently our error payload is minimal. We should add a clearer validation error for types.

alex.k: Customer asks for repro steps so they can patch their client. Suggested repro: send items as a JSON string. Example curl: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"items":"[{\"id\":\"1\",\"text\":\"x\"}]","query":"x","topK":1}'
```

maria.cs: Thanks. I'll open an internal bug to improve our 400 when the type is wrong and include a link to the docs. Also add a short troubleshooting note to support KB: "clients that accidentally JSON.stringify candidate arrays".

support-bot: New internal issue created: INF-8123 — Improve rerank type validation error messages (assigned to ryan.eng).

ryan.eng: I'll take INF-8123. Quick plan: return 400 + error.code TYPE_MISMATCH + error.detail "items must be an array of candidate objects, not a string". Also add sample "bad" vs "good" snippet in docs.

alex.k: Customer update: they're patching serializer now. Will confirm after deploy. Leaving ticket open for verification.

maria.cs: Can we add a telemetry metric to count string-in-items occurrences so we can alert if a rollout of a client starts doing this?

ingest-team: Yep we can add a parsing-error counter tag=rerank.items.type_string. Will add to next sprint.

alex.k: Thanks all. I'll post final customer confirmation when they test. :thumbsup:
